---
title: "Automatic batch simulation"
---

::: {.excel-operation}
**Where in PEExcel?** [Scen]{.excel-menu .red} (batch simulation).
:::

Batch simulation calculates many variants. It complements calculation of a single active variant and prepares joint analysis.

## Workflow

1. [Create and save variants](variants.qmd) with clear names and documented questions.
2. Assemble the batch variants on **Scen**.
3. Invoke [Simulieren]{.excel-action}. The tool checks selections and estimates calculation time.
4. Confirm successful checks and start, or cancel.
5. Review calculation status and errors; associate results with variants.
6. Evaluate calculated variants in [comparison](comparison.qmd) or [Python](python.qmd).

Do not treat failed or uncalculated variants as a complete comparison group. Document inputs, tool version and calculation status together.

Source: [Training, slide 33: batch simulation](../downloads/schulung.pdf#page=33) (German).

## Automating with Python

[Batch simulation with Python (German)](../batch-python.html) demonstrates `pexl.batch.run_batch`: select scenarios from SCEN or a CSV/Excel list, save annual results, resume jobs and optionally export hourly values.
